title: NER experiment log entry
description: Single normalized schema for packages/training/experiments/log.jsonl (#293). Every row — hypothesis test, benchmark version change, or baseline comparison — is expressed through the same 10 fields so an agent can machine-parse 'previous best for {language, baseline}' without re-reading history in prose. Fields present in a pre-#293 row that do not map onto this shape are preserved verbatim, without alteration, under `legacy` so the migration loses zero information.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp, JST (+09:00) by convention for this project.

language.description: Target language of the run, e.g. 'ja' or 'en'.

baseline.description: Identifier of the benchmark/dataset this run's metrics are measured against. Combined with `language` this is the grouping key for experiments/best.json — every run sharing {language, baseline} is directly comparable.

hypothesis.description: What the run changed and why, in one sentence.

intervention_type.description: Category of intervention (e.g. data_augmentation, data_generation, training_config, label_mapping, baseline_comparison, benchmark_versioning). Free-form string, not enum-constrained, since new intervention categories are expected as the project evolves.

metrics_before.description: Metric snapshot prior to the intervention. Empty object ({}) is valid when the run has no natural 'before' state (e.g. a one-shot baseline comparison).

metrics_after.description: Metric snapshot after the intervention. Runs that participate in experiments/best.json ranking MUST include a numeric 'overall_f1' key here.

verdict.description: KEEP: intervention adopted. DISCARD: intervention rejected/reverted. NO_DECISION: comparison/meta record with no keep-or-discard action (e.g. benchmark version bump, tied baseline comparison).

data_hash.description: sha256 hex digest of the training/eval input data file used for this run. 'unknown' for rows migrated from before this field existed (#293) — the original data is no longer hashable after the fact.

reason.description: Optional human-readable justification for the verdict.

duration_minutes.description: Optional wall-clock duration of the run.

legacy.description: Optional escape hatch. For rows migrated from the pre-#293 log format, this holds the *entire original JSON object* verbatim, so every field that existed before migration is still recoverable even though it is not part of the normalized schema above. New rows appended via scripts/log_experiment.py do not set this field.
